name: Food Handler Card / Certificate
about: Basic food safety certificate your local health department requires or expects for food workers.

name: Certified Food Protection Manager
about: Nationally accredited food protection manager certification (for example ServSafe Manager).

name: Allergen Awareness
about: The major food allergens, cross-contact, reading labels and what to do when a guest reports an allergy.

name: Handwashing & Personal Hygiene
about: When and how to wash hands, glove use, illness reporting, clean uniforms and hair restraints.

name: Cross-Contamination & Date Marking
about: Storage order, separating raw and ready-to-eat food, labeling and use-by dates.

name: Time & Temperature Control
about: Safe temperatures, cooling, reheating, hot and cold holding, and logging temperatures.

name: Chemical Safety & SDS (HazCom)
about: Chemical labels, safety data sheets, PPE, never mixing chemicals, and spill and exposure response.

name: Dish Machine & Sanitizer Testing
about: Running the dish machine, checking temperature or sanitizer strength, and sanitizing sinks and surfaces.

name: Knife & Cutting Safety
about: Safe knife handling, cut-resistant gloves and cutting board use.
appliesTo: Prep, Salads, Front Line, Back Line

name: Slicer / Mixer / Equipment Safety
about: Guards, lockout, cleaning and safe operation of slicers, mixers and other powered equipment.

name: Burns, Hot Oil & Fryer Safety
about: Handling hot oil, fryer filtering, hot pans and steam, and first aid for burns.

name: Slips, Trips & Falls / General Safety
about: Wet floors, mats, lifting, ladders and keeping walkways clear.

name: Fire Extinguisher & Emergency Procedures
about: Where extinguishers and exits are, how to use an extinguisher, and the emergency plan.

name: New Hire Orientation
about: Kitchen rules, schedules, uniforms, safety walk-through and who to ask.
